pointers.sentence: `django.contrib.gis.forms` is all of `django.forms` and, beside it, the map widgets and a form field for each kind of geometry: `django.contrib.gis.forms.fields.GeometryField` and its subclasses, `PointField` and the rest, differing only in `geom_type` (`django/contrib/gis/forms/fields.py:GeometryField`).

A model's geometry field makes its own, passing its kind, its SRID and `max_geom_collections`, a limit on nested collections that keeps hostile input from crashing GEOS (`django/contrib/gis/db/models/fields.py:GeometryField.formfield`).

`BaseGeometryWidget` keeps its options, `base_layer`, `geom_type`, `map_srid` and `display_raw`, as class attributes, copied into the widget's `attrs` when it is made (`django/contrib/gis/forms/widgets.py:BaseGeometryWidget`).

It reads the textarea as GeoJSON and writes changes back the same way, naming no projection (`django/contrib/gis/static/gis/js/OLMapWidget.js`); and `OpenLayersWidget.deserialize` reads GeoJSON in the map's SRID, where GeoJSON, its comment says, assumes 4326.

`GISModelAdmin` is `ModelAdmin` behind `GeoModelAdminMixin`, whose `formfield_for_dbfield` gives a geometry field of two dimensions, or of three if `supports_3d` allows, the model field's own form field with the widget `gis_widget`, `OSMWidget` by default, made with `gis_widget_kwargs` (`django/contrib/gis/admin/options.py:GeoModelAdminMixin.formfield_for_dbfield`).

It writes a FeatureCollection, and for each instance a Feature whose `"id"` is the key or id_field's value, whose `"properties"` are the other fields, with the key as `"pk"` unless a fields list leaves it out, and whose `"geometry"` is the first geometry field's, or geometry_field's, transformed into srid (`django/contrib/gis/serializers/geojson.py:Serializer.get_dump_object`).

`django/contrib/gis/feeds.py:Feed` is `django.contrib.syndication.views.Feed` with `GeoRSSFeed` as its generator and two more dynamic attributes, `"geometry"` for the feed and `"item_geometry"` for each item, which `Feed.feed_extra_kwargs` and `Feed.item_extra_kwargs` hand to the generator ([Feeds: `django.contrib.syndication` and the feed generator](feeds.md)).

`KMLSitemap` lists geometry fields, not objects: triples of an application label, a model name and a field name, from the models or triples given or, by default, from every geometry field of every installed model (`django/contrib/gis/sitemaps/kml.py:KMLSitemap`).

It renders "gis/kml/placemarks.kml" with `render_to_kml`, as "application/vnd.google-earth.kml+xml", or with `render_to_kmz`, which zips it as "doc.kml" (`django/contrib/gis/sitemaps/views.py:kml`, `django/contrib/gis/shortcuts.py:compress_kml`).

GDAL reads a file of geographic data, a shapefile or GeoJSON, as a `DataSource` of layers of features, each with the layer's fields and a geometry. ogrinspect writes a model for a layer, each OGR field type mapped to a model field type with the layer's widths, and a geometry field of the layer's type, with the layer's SRID, or -1 if it has none, unless that is 4326, the default (`django/contrib/gis/utils/ogrinspect.py:_ogrinspect`); `--mapping` adds the dictionary `LayerMapping` wants (`django/contrib/gis/management/commands/ogrinspect.py:Command.handle`).

GDAL reads a file of geographic data, a shapefile or GeoJSON, as a `DataSource` of layers of features, each with the layer's fields and a geometry. ogrinspect writes a model for a layer, each OGR field type mapped to a model field type with the layer's widths, and a geometry field of the layer's type, with the layer's SRID, or -1 if it has none, unless that is 4326, the default (`django/contrib/gis/utils/ogrinspect.py:_ogrinspect`); `--mapping` adds the dictionary `LayerMapping` wants (`django/contrib/gis/management/commands/ogrinspect.py:Command.handle`).
`LayerMapping` saves a layer's features as rows (`django/contrib/gis/utils/layermapping.py:LayerMapping`).

In the default mode, "commit_on_success", the load is one `atomic` block of the default database, whichever database it writes to (`django/db/transaction.py:atomic`); with `step=1000`, each thousand features are one, the last taking the rest; "autocommit" uses none.

`add_srs_entry` adds a coordinate system GDAL knows to the spatial_ref_sys of PostGIS or SpatiaLite, if no row has its SRID (`django/contrib/gis/utils/srs.py:add_srs_entry`); GeoDjango's inspectdb asks the backend's introspection for each geometry column's type and, except on MySQL, its SRID (`django/contrib/gis/management/commands/inspectdb.py:Command.get_field_type`) ([The commands Django ships](../commands/builtin.md)).
